name: css-eval-griffel
description: SAPP-4639 prototype: @sanity/ui-style Button on Griffel (atomic CSS-in-JS), two versions on one page

scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./tsdown-plugin build && pnpm --filter ./button build && pnpm --filter ./button-v2 build
scripts.pack:tarballs: rm -f app/tarballs/*.tgz && (cd button && pnpm pack --pack-destination ../app/tarballs) && (cd button-v2 && pnpm pack --pack-destination ../app/tarballs)
